_comment: Hand-curated step lists for the explanatory schematics (stocks/lib/schematics.js builds the drawable specs; stocks/lib/flow-diagram.js draws them). A step is never invented: every step names the file and field it comes from (`source.ref`, a path into stocks/data/) and the words in that field it rests on (`source.basis`, which stocks/schematics.test.js checks is a verbatim substring). `status` is observed (read off the chain), documented, inferred, litigated or unknown; an unknown step is drawn dashed. A `url` given here must appear in the referenced file. What-if sequences and relationship maps are derived, not listed here.
